session_read: Overnight KOSPI +17.9% (record single-day) and US SMH +6.9% yesterday are a snapback off the 07-28/29 circuit-breaker crash, not a fundamentals re-rating -- primary named catalyst is MSFT's Azure beat, but the CXMT/DUV structural threat that caused the crash remains unresolved. Peer-relative-strength confirms most memory/optics names are still deep laggards despite the bounce. Refreshed risk caps show the rally itself pushed 11 positions over their ATR-based stops -- a sell-the-bounce, not chase-the-rally, setup.
